fields.subject: Notice of circumstances: ransomware incident
fields.body: Ardent Ridge Manufacturing gives notice under the policy of a ransomware incident discovered on October 22, 2026. Counsel has engaged a forensic firm. No payment to the actor has been made or authorized.

items.detail: Production scheduling at two of five plants; file servers.
Not yet known whether personal data was taken.
Cryptocurrency payment within seven days; the note threatens publication.

fields.request: Please confirm the claim number, the panel vendors we should use and the steps required before any contact with the actor.
fields.reservation: This notice is given on the facts known now and will be updated as the investigation continues.

fields.from: Mei Tanaka, Audit Engagement Partner (fictional firm)
fields.to: Chief Financial Officer; Audit Committee Chair
fields.subject: Inquiry about the October 2026 cybersecurity incident
fields.body: As part of the audit, we ask management to describe the incident and its effect on internal control over financial reporting and on the financial statements.

items.detail: Which financial reporting systems and controls were affected, if any?
Management's range of loss and when it will be accrued or disclosed.
The disclosure committee's determination and its documented basis.
Any events after the balance sheet date related to the incident.

fields.request: Please respond in writing by November 3 and make the disclosure committee's records available.
